qualification.details: post name: Minimum Educational Qualification | medical officer-rbsk (male/female): BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree with registration from a Government of India-recognized Ayush, Homeopathy, or Unani Registration Board | lab supervisor (stls): Graduate; Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (or equivalent) from a Government-recognized institution; permanent two-wheeler driving license; certificate course in computer operations (minimum 2 months); preference given to candidates with at least 1 year of experience in NTEP/RNTCP | physiotherapist (nhm): Bachelor's Degree in Physiotherapy (BPT) with live registration | lab technician (dphl): Higher Secondary (10+2) in Biology with BMLT, or with DMLT, or with a one-year Paramedical Technician certificate course (CMLT); registration with the Paramedical Council of India or Chhattisgarh Paramedical Council (preference: BMLT, then DMLT, then CMLT) | technical assistant – hearing impaired children (nppcd): Diploma in Training Young Deaf and Hearing Handicapped (DTYDHH) from an RCI-recognized institute | staff nurse (sncu / nbsu / nrc): B.Sc Nursing or GNM course passed with live registration in the Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council | community health officer (cho): B.Sc Nursing Certificate in Community Health Integrated Course, or Post Basic B.Sc Nursing Certificate in Community Health Integrated Course, with live registration in the Chhattisgarh Nursing Registration Council | counsellor (nhm): PG Degree/Diploma in Psychology, Counseling, Health Education, Mass Communication, or Social Science | junior secretariat assistant (nhm / uhwc): 12th passed with a one-year Diploma in Computer Application | secretariat assistant (sa-nhm): Graduate with a one-year Diploma in Computer Application | attendant (nrc): 8th passed | ayah bai (sncu): 8th passed

selection_process: Selection under CMHO Balrampur Recruitment 2026 is based on a combined score:

Educational qualification: 65% weight of marks obtained Experience: up to 10 marks (2 marks per year for other candidates) or up to 15 marks (3 marks per year for candidates already working under NHM)
maximum 5 years counted Skill/written test or interview: 20 marks
Based on qualification and experience marks
a category-wise (unreserved/SC/ST/OBC) merit list of candidates is prepared for the written test
or interview stage. Candidates must score at least 30% in the skill/written test/interview to remain eligible; those scoring below 30% will be treated as disqualified.
Selection method differs by post group:
Attendant (NRC) Skill/proficiency test: Junior Secretariat Assistant (NHM/UHWC)
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for CMHO Balrampur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.balrampur.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.

Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: CMHO Balrampur Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection under CMHO Balrampur Recruitment 2026 is based on a combined score: Educational qualification: 65% weight of marks obtained Experience: up to 10 marks (2 marks per year for other candidates) or up to 15 marks (3 marks per year for candidates already working under NHM), maximum 5 years counted Skill/written test or interview: 20 marks Based on qualification and experience marks, a category-wise (unreserved/SC/ST/OBC) merit list of candidates is prepared for the written test, skill test, or interview stage. Candidates must score at least 30% in the skill/written test/interview to remain eligible; those scoring below 30% will be treated as disqualified. Selection method differs by post group: Interview/written test: Medical Officer-RBSK (Male/Female), Lab Supervisor (STLS), Staff Nurse (NRC/SNCU/NBSU), Physiotherapist, Ayah Bai, Lab Technician (DPHL), Technical Assistant (NPPCD), Community Health Officer, Counsellor, Attendant (NRC) Skill/proficiency test: Junior Secretariat Assistant (NHM/UHWC), Secretariat Assistant (SA-NHM)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CMHO Balrampur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.balrampur.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Chief Medical and Health Office Balrampur (CMHO Balrampur), Chhattisgarh, for various health department positions under the National Health Mission.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in CMHO Balrampur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 60 vacancies available for multiple healthcare and administrative posts including Medical Officer, Staff Nurse, Community Health Officer, and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled offline application form is 12 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for CMHO Balrampur posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly Offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for applicants is 18 years, and the maximum age limit goes up to 64 or 70 years depending on the specific post you are applying for.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Staff Nurse positions must possess a B.Sc Nursing or GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) degree from a recognized institution registered with the nursing council.

faq.question: Q7. Where should I send the completed offline application form?
faq.answer: The completed application form along with self-attested documents should be sent to the Office of Chief Medical and Health Officer, Balrampur-Ramanujganj, Chhattisgarh, via Speed Post or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, application fees vary based on category and salary bracket, ranging from ₹100/- for reserved categories up to ₹400/- for unreserved categories depending on whether the post salary is above or below ₹25,000.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CMHO Balrampur Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes evaluation of Educational Qualification Marks, Experience Marks, and a Skill or Written Test as mandated for the respective job roles.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF and application format from the official Balrampur district website at www.balrampur.gov.in or through the direct links provided in this article.
